Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Avenging the Fallen
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality: Straighten him. If another player's Battle action has destroyed one of your Personalities this battle, negate the performer's next destruction from cards' effects (this turn).

Cards.Name: Lessons from the Heralds
Cards.Text: Battle: If one of your Personalities has won a duel this turn, look at the top three cards of your Fate deck. Put one into your hand. Put the rest back in any order.
